Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target. LEFT JOIN docs on assays.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id and doi. LEFT JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. INNER JOIN compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and require both canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id OR doi) to be non-null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not use DISTINCT. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
